title: Biome Updated
description: This mod Aims to Update all Biomes on Minecraft. Start from the Plains Biome and Ending on The End
body:
Available on Modrinth & Curseforge and on (Neoforge 1.21.8, & Neoforge 1.21.1)

The mod now based on biomes Related Stuff, and no more new biomes, dimension, & other not useful stuff, and also keeping it Semi-Industrial Age, as minecraft entering the Semi-Industrial Era. Also Pre-Release & Release Candidate is releasing if there a Texture Change / Bugs Found, so it's optional 

<details>
<summary>All Biomes not Updated/Revamped</summary>

 Snowy Plains
- Snowy Taiga (Black Bears will still spawn) 
- All Ocean Biome
- Deep Dark
- All Mountains Biome
- All Nether & End Dimension Related Biome


</details>
